question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A sound that is pleasing to hear
solution:
The correct answer is '**Melodious**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Melodious**'.
 
• It means 'pleasant to listen to, like music'. (श्रुतिमधुर, सुरीला)
 
 
• *Example: a rich **melodious** voice...*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Melodious.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Inspired**: influenced or helped by a particular feeling, thing or person. (विशेष मनोभाव, वस्‍तु या व्‍यक्ति द्वारा प्रेरित)
 
• **Harsh**: very strict and unkind. (बहुत कठोर और निर्मम)
 
• **Audible**: that can be heard. (श्रव्‍य; सुनी जा सकने योग्‍य)
